title: Tiger Spirit in the Marsh
description: A large purple tiger stands in the foreground with its head turned in profile, its body filled with translucent scenes of an ancient village and tribal patterns. From its open mouth flows a luminous stream of golden water that merges with a marshy pond filled with lily pads and reflections. Paw prints float in the air and on the water, while a second faint tiger silhouette appears in the sunlit background among trees and tall grass.
prompt: A majestic purple tiger in profile standing at the edge of a marsh pond, its translucent body revealing an ancient village and tribal carvings inside its form. Golden light streams from its mouth into the water creating glowing reflections and lily pads. Floating black paw prints rise through the air. A second ghostly tiger silhouette appears in the sunlit grassy background among trees. Mystical atmosphere with soft god rays and rich color transitions between purple foreground and golden background.
